fact: The South African edtech accelerator Injini launched an eight-month programme for twelve startup teams in Southern Africa building affordable classroom AI tools, with seed funding for the top five, per wearetech.africa.

The Department of Small Business Development says four digital hubs were established (Mbombela, Gert Sibande, Mafikeng, Botshabelo) and the remaining two would be completed in the second and third quarters of 2021/22, with no programme or cohort described.

The Department of Communications and Digital Technologies says its Deputy Minister launched the African Digital Transformation Centre at The Innovation Hub in Pretoria, set up with the ITU, with no programme or cohort described.
